incidental_findings.finding: Four items share the IDENTICAL stem 'What number do the blocks show?' with four different answers (13, 24, 16, 22), so the entire discriminative content sits in an image. 'Use base-10 blocks to show the number 31' is undoable unless a manipulative is actually supplied; the key '31' suggests the response is graded as a number, which would not confirm the pupil built 3 tens and 1 one rather than typing '31'. 'Move the dot to show 30 on the number line' does not establish the line's endpoints, interval or labelling, and the key is a value rather than a position.
The number range collapses to 13-36 with no value above 36 in ten draws; only two modalities appear; no bar model at all despite the clause naming it.
